failures.name: calc-inline: Nimbus expected value of contract profit (numbers supplied inline, no data file)
failures.question: Software-as-a-service start-up firm Nimbus 2K is weighing the uncertainty around a proposal to pursue a major contract. Their data scientist estimates the following set of potential outcomes: there is an 18% chance the firm wins the contract and earns a profit of $700,000; there is a 12% chance the firm wins the contract but incurs higher expenses, earning a profit of $500,000; otherwise the firm loses the contract and earns no profit. The expected value of the contract profit is closest to which of the following?
